steps.en: Install the app on your Mac
steps.zh: 在 Mac 上装好应用

steps.en: Import the OPML export from your old reader, or add feeds by hand
steps.zh: 导入旧阅读器导出的 OPML，或手动添加订阅

steps.en: Background-refreshes each feed and parses RSS/Atom/JSON Feed into one chronological list
steps.zh: 后台刷新每个订阅源，解析成一条按时间排序的列表

steps.en: Read and mark articles with single-key shortcuts
steps.zh: 用单键快捷键阅读、标记文章

steps.en: Keeps subscriptions and read state in sync on your iPhone through the account you picked
steps.zh: 通过你选的账号，把订阅和已读状态同步到 iPhone

value.en: A fast, telemetry-free chronological reader on Mac and iPhone — no account to start, no ads, no subscription fee
value.zh: Mac 和 iPhone 上快而无遥测的时间线阅读器——上手不用账号，没有广告和订阅费

sources: https://netnewswire.com/ (features list: 'Importing and exporting OPML feed lists', 'Single-key keyboard shortcuts', 'Background refreshing', 'Syncing via iCloud, Feedbin, Feedly, BazQux, Inoreader, NewsBlur, The Old Reader, and FreshRSS')
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ranchero-Software/NetNewsWire/main/README.md (supports RSS, Atom, JSON Feed, and RSS-in-JSON formats)
